{{Quote|The ship's sending out seismic tanks. They look modified.|Kit Fisto|<ref name="Act" />}}
A '''seismic tank''', also referred to as "'''seismic charge minelayer'''" or "'''seismic hover tank'''," was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorcraft]] that traveled very close to the surface of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and inflicted damage to an opposing force by ejecting a [[Seismic driver|large piston]] downward onto the enemy, smashing them, and then creating a shockwave that rippled away from its impact zone. It was originally designed by [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]] for the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] vehicle used to tear up the surface of a planet to reveal precious [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]]. However, with the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Tank/Legends|tank]] was put to military use.

A seismic tank saw action during the [[Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)|Battle of Dantooine]], though it was destroyed by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], who leaped onto the side of the tank and cut his way in with his [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. A number of seismic tanks were deployed during [[Project Instinction]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]], where they released soil gathered from the [[Badlands (Moorja)|badlands]] of the planet [[Moorja]] in an effort to cover Ukio's [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]] and block out the [[Ukio system's star|sunlight]] from reaching the [[Farm/Legends|crops]] on the surface.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Recharge accelerators.''"<br />"''Roger, roger.|Battle droids in the tank's command bridge|audio=Recharge_accelerators.flac|<ref name="CW2">{{CW|13}}</ref>}}
[[File:Seismic_tank_space.png|thumb|left|300px|The tank's space variant prepares to drop its chemical payload.]]
The seismic [[Tank/Legends|tank]], also referred to as "seismic charge [[Minelayer (starship type)|minelayer]]"<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> or "seismic hover tank,"<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|136|seismic hover tank}}</ref> was a massive, fifty-five-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] craft with a huge [[seismic driver]] in its core. Magnetic impellers guided the driver, which was almost frictionless, through a channel located in the center of the tank. The heavy metal core of the driver gave it an enormous amount of inertia as it fell toward the ground below. The impellers were also responsible for keeping the driver perfectly centered in the channel and for making sure the resulting shockwave did not travel up the shaft and into the rest of the vehicle.<ref name="DB" />

Four repulsorlift generators carried the tank at heights of up to thirty meters, while stabilizing repulsorlifts lined the tank's lower section. To result in its full [[Gravity/Legends|gravitic]] force being intact upon impact, the repulsorlifts did not envelop the entire craft. This resulted in the tank being very unwieldy and slow. The seismic tank was operated from a topside command bridge by a team of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. [[Maintenance droid/Legends|Repair droids]] monitored the driver, as misalignment could result in a shockwave ripping the vehicle apart. The tank was also capable of being modified for [[Realspace/Legends|space]] flight and use as a soil dispenser onto [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]].<ref name="Act" />

==Role==
The seismic tank was originally used for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] purposes. When the driver would exit the channel and impact the ground, the resulting force would pulverize the terrestrial surface and expose harder [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] and metals. The tank was also used for military purposes as a form of self-propelled [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]], as the driver could be used to crush enemy forces.<ref name="DB" /> Modified versions of the tank could also carry payloads of soil.<ref name="Act" />

==History==
===Devastation on Dantooine===
{{Quote|Fire at will."<br />"Roger, roger.|Battle droids in the tank's command bridge|<ref name="CW2" />}}
[[File:Seismic_tank_attacks.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A seismic tank's driver was fired during the Battle of Dantooine.]]
Seismic tanks were a result of the skilled legal departments of megacorporations like the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] that were capable of finessing legislation passed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for the purpose of limiting the military prowess of large companies. The tank was legally designed by [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]] as a mining tank, and this was how companies such as the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] were able to justify its use. However, when the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], there was no longer a need for such excuses.<ref name="DB" />

An instance of the tank seeing use for military purposes occurred during the [[Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)|Battle of Dantooine]]. A large [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] fought in a large open plain as a seismic tank hovered overhead. To the [[Cloning/Legends|clones']] surprise, the tank dropped its driver and smashed the forces below, destroying [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] alike.<ref name="CW">{{CW|12}}</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] fought his way into the tank with his [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and destroyed it from the inside. The entire incident was witnessed by a young [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] named [[Paxi Sylo]].<ref name="CW2" />

===Unloading on Ukio===
{{Quote|They're dropping something into the atmosphere. What is it?|Kit Fisto witnesses the seismic tanks' payload of soil over Ukio|<ref name="Act" />}}
[[File:Moorja_badlands.png|thumb|left|300px|Seismic tanks were loaded with badlands soil on Moorja for deployment over Ukio.]]
Around 22 BBY,<ref name="Date">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'' depicts the destruction of the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] during the [[Battle of Ukio|battle]] at [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]], which takes place not long after the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Battle of Devaron]]&mdash;an event that {{FactFile2014|88|22 BBY 97-98|Bane of the Jedi Order}} dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> as part of [[Project Instinction]], a plan by<ref name="Act" /> [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] and his<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref> [[Tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] [[Doctor (tactical droid)|Doctor]] to bring the<ref name="Act" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] under Confederate control, modified seismic tanks were loaded with electrostatic soil from the [[Badlands (Moorja)|badlands]] of the<ref name="Act" /> [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Journal8">{{JournalCite|8|Black Curs Blues}}</ref> [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]] before being carried to Ukio by a single [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Ukio)|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]. Upon arrival in the [[Ukio system/Legends|Ukio system]], the ship was detected by the planet's [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] network, which alerted both the local [[Ukian government|government]] and patrolling [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] forces, causing suspicion among the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Keelyvine Reus]] due to the ship's apparent lack of threat to the planetary shields.<ref name="Act" />

[[File:ProjectInstinctionPhase1-ActOnInstinct.png|thumb|right|300px|Seismic tanks deploy electrostatic soil onto Ukio's planetary shields.]]
The two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attempted to reconnoiter the vessel in [[Keelyvine Reus's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|their]] [[Kit Fisto's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]], and as they approached, the battleship deployed the modified seismic tanks, which released their payloads of badland soil containing photoreactive properties onto the shields. With Republic frequencies [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] by the ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship, the Jedi were unsuccessful in their attempts to thwart the plan by blowing up several seismic tanks. The Republic identified the material being dropped by the tanks and deduced its purpose&mdash;block out the light from [[Ukio system's star|Ukio's sun]] with material that would cling to the shields and stay aligned with the [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] the [[Farm/Legends|crops]] beneath.<ref name="Act" />

The Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Battle of Ukio|attacked]] the battleship while Ukio's shields were lowered in an effort to disperse the soil. Taking advantage of the new gap in defenses, the battleship dispatched its [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to engage Republic forces while Doctor reached the planet's surface and deployed [[Project Instinction device|neural broadcast transmitters]], causing many lifeforms to behave aggressively. Though the Republic defeated the Separatist forces at Ukio, the Confederacy was able to use the [[Economics/Legends|financial]] instability on Ukio caused by the event to [[Currency/Legends|purchase]] the planet.<ref name="Act" />

==Behind the scenes==
The seismic tank first appeared in the [[Chapter 12 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|twelfth chapter]] of the animated television miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="CW" /> The episode aired on [[Cartoon Network]] on [[March 29]], [[2004]].<ref name="TV.com">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-xii-276618|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 1, Episode 12: Chapter XII}}</ref>
